persona_summary: BA 5th-year, Strategic Management, Psychology minor, 60 courses, Good standing
question: I have a job starting in June 2026 and I absolutely cannot extend past Spring 2026. I think I have everything done but I want you to double-check and plan my final semester to be safe.
false_assumption_or_hidden_conflict: The student assumes they're essentially done with 60 courses. However, with a Psychology minor that has specific course requirements offered only in certain semesters, there may be a single remaining Psychology minor course that is NOT offered in Spring 2026 — meaning the student can't finish on time despite being 'almost done.'
naive_system_response: A naive system would confirm 'you're almost done!' and list 1-2 remaining courses, possibly without checking whether those specific courses are actually offered in Spring 2026.
correct_response: After auditing your 60 courses against BA + Strategic Management + Psychology minor requirements, you are missing [specific course(s)]. Unfortunately, [course X] for your Psychology minor is only offered in [Fall/specific semester], not Spring 2026. Your options: (1) find a substitute course that satisfies the same requirement and IS offered in Spring 2026, (2) petition for a course substitution, (3) take it during Summer 2026 before your job starts if timing permits.
why_multi_agent_helps: The Programs Agent audits 60 courses and finds the gap. The Courses Agent verifies offering schedules and detects the availability problem. A single agent might confirm near-completion without cross-referencing the final requirement against the Spring 2026 schedule — missing the one course that's unavailable.
key_facts: P-029 has 60 courses — close to completion but not verified complete
Psychology minor has specific requirements that may not all be offered every semester
Job start date creates a hard deadline
One missing course in the wrong semester can derail graduation
known_traps: Assuming 60 courses means requirements are met without actually auditing
Confirming completion without checking Spring 2026 offering schedule
Not suggesting alternatives when the missing course isn't offered
advisor_validation_needed: Verify: (1) exact remaining requirements after auditing 60 courses, (2) whether any remaining Psychology minor course is not offered Spring 2026, (3) whether a substitute exists, (4) summer course option timing relative to June job start
